Rate limit runbook. HTTP 429 means that the upstream service is rate limiting requests. Inspect Retry-After and the agreed client quota. Respect Retry-After before retrying. Use bounded exponential backoff with jitter and reduce concurrency after operator approval. Do not blindly replay non-idempotent payments or orders. Verify idempotency keys and downstream transaction status before proposing replay. A successful retry does not prove the quota issue has been permanently resolved.
